name: Flaresolverr Fetch
description: Fetch URLs through a flaresolverr instance to bypass Cloudflare anti-bot challenges. Self-hosted endpoints only.

endpoint.label: Flaresolverr Endpoint
endpoint.help: Base URL of the flaresolverr instance (e.g. http://flaresolverr:8191). Must target a private/internal network.

defaultTimeoutSeconds.label: Default Request Timeout (s)
defaultTimeoutSeconds.help: Default per-request timeout passed to flaresolverr.
